name: ExchangeRate-API
label: ExchangeRate-API
description: ExchangeRate-API official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: latest, historical, convert, quota. Docs: https://www.exchangerate-api.com/docs/standard-requests. ExchangeRate-API v6 (https://v6.exchangerate-api.com). Key in path (or Bearer with key omitted from path — this node uses path keys). HTTPS for all keyed plans including Free. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One ExchangeRate-API request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"latest"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: latest | historical | convert | quota. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'latest'.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: convert path amount. Optional (pair without amount still works). Example: 25.5.

schema.label: base_code
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `base_code` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: day
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `day` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: month
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `month` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: target_code
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `target_code` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: year
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `year` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: latest, historical, convert, quota.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: v6 API key used in the path. Bind a StudioQuack secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
